data_policy: Freeze dataset version/hash, actual permissions, identity/lineage/duplicate audit, model training overlap and prior exposure before final candidate selection. Existing N0 is exposed research data, not formal train/validation/test or independent evaluation. Never adjust final-test identities, thresholds or exclusions after scores.

detection.metric: official WIDER FACE Easy/Medium/Hard AP and PR
detection.engine: official evaluation code, pinned version, not scalar average in this module
detection.development: WIDER train internal development split; official val frozen evaluation unless explicitly declared used for tuning

landmarks.metric: 2D NME ratio with explicit semantic point IDs/order, shared coordinate frame, visibility mask and positive normalization distance
landmarks.note: The generic function is not an AFLW2000 official protocol. Freeze actual benchmark annotation/index mapping, invisible-point policy and normalizer before comparing results.

age_geometry_identity_uv.units: identity; source geometry/coordinate system/topology fixed; source labels, generated conditions and evaluator estimates separate

system.record: CPU/GPU/provider/device/version/input resolution separately; latency and requests/failures/cancellation, peak resources and cleanup. Chrome/Edge stable, ordinary graphics and intentional camera motion remain distinct exits.

statistics.scalar_scope: per-request scalar research metrics only; not AP or a replacement for benchmark evaluators
statistics.ledger: One frozen complete request_id/subject_id/stratum ledger, exactly one explicit ok/failed result per request per variant
statistics.aggregation: Reuse age_statistics.aggregate_identity_metrics; mean within identity, equal-weight identity macro; report full request and identity denominators plus conditional valid metrics
statistics.comparison: Right minus left on each pair's common successful request IDs only, average paired differences within identity then across identities. Keep left-only/right-only/both-failed requests and original errors; never subtract macros computed on different sets.

bootstrap.ci: linear-interpolated2.5/97.5 percentiles of identity-mean resamples; null below2 eligible identities

statistics.retrospective_validation: Known K2 results may validate arithmetic, not become newly preregistered or independent evidence.
